title: CogGym: Towards Large-Scale Comparative Evaluation of Human and Machine Cognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.21259v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding and modeling human intelligence are parallel goals shared by artificial intelligence (AI) and cognitive science. As AI systems grow increasingly capable, in what ways do model responses resemble human responses, and where do they systematically diverge? The sheer breadth and diversity of the tasks humans can perform and think about pose a challenge for scalable and rigorous comparison between humans and models. We introduce CogGym, a scalable, unified framework grounded in cognitive science for systematically comparing model and human behavior on matched experimental trials. CogGym uses a semi-automated, human-in-the-loop pipeline to standardize diverse experimental paradigms into a task-agnostic Experiment Markup Language (EML), enabling reproducible and faithful comparison at scale. translated_title: CogGym：迈向人类与机器认知的大规模比较评估
translated_abstract: 理解与建模人类智能是人工智能（AI）与认知科学共同追求的并行目标。随着AI系统能力的日益增强，模型的响应在哪些方面与人类响应相似，又在哪些方面存在系统性差异？人类能够执行和思考的任务之广泛与多样，为人类与模型之间可扩展且严谨的比较带来了巨大挑战。我们提出了CogGym，这是一个以认知科学为基础的可扩展统一框架，用于在匹配的实验试次上系统性地比较模型与人类的行为。CogGym采用半自动化、人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的流水线，将多样化的实验范式标准化为一种与任务无关的实验标记语言（EML），从而实现大规模、可复现且忠实的比较。在初始发布中，我们从100篇论文中整理并标准化了258个聚焦于人类常识推理的认知实验，并评……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出CogGym框架，通过半自动化流水线将认知科学实验标准化为任务无关的实验标记语言（EML），实现了对258个人类常识推理认知实验中人类与模型行为的大规模、可复现的系统比较。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CogGym, a scalable cognitive-science-grounded framework that standardizes diverse experimental paradigms into a task-agnostic Experiment Markup Language (EML), enabling large-scale, reproducible comparison of human and model behavior across 258 curated commonsense reasoning experiments.
